notes: Encoded independently from Kelvinator's own page; no usesStylesOf. The page lists Nordyne-family sister/similar brands, but a shared-parent listing alone does not establish shared styles, so both styles are transcribed in full from this page. Counting (Nordyne lesson): the page states positions as 'numerical digits', but digit-only counting is falsified by style 1's own example — digits of FGA030310579 are 030310579, whose 4th & 5th digits are '31' (1931 below the 1960 floor, 2031 future: no valid resolution), while character counting gives year '03' and month '03', both valid, and decodes style 2's example identically to the Benson/Ambirad character reading (1999-05). Character counting is therefore this page's coherent convention and is used throughout. Page images are diagrams, not letter tables; no chart values were needed.

styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open [3,5] and [5,7] under character counting (see file notes for the falsification of digit-only counting).
